concepts.name: Blue anchor
concepts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Aboiteau logo exploration, one variant per image.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: retain its warm ivory background, landscape 3:2 presentation, large standalone A above and smaller horizontal A-plus-wordmark lockup below. Image 2 is the approved geometry reference and has priority for the shape.
Preserve the A's broad outer silhouette, rounded apex and feet, exact two-piece construction, triangular inner counter, and generous completely straight parallel-edged diagonal ivory channel rising left to right. Keep the counter and cut open. Do not change the wordmark's sturdy near-black lowercase human grotesk style, text, or spacing. Change only the placement and treatment of the colour swatches inside the A. The small lockup must repeat the large mark's new colour arrangement faithfully.
Brand palette: ultramarine #1746D1, vermilion #F04B32, sunny yellow #F7D447, restrained pink #ED5798, ivory paper #F6EEDD, wordmark ink #212722. Colours approximate within generated artwork.
All colour swatches stay INSIDE the A. Keep large readable masses. No detached colour chips, labels, extra marks, rainbow stripes, equal horizontal bands, stars, flags, maps, boats, gradients, shadows, bevels, glow, mockups, borders or watermark.
Text verbatim: "aboiteau". No other text.
Specific variant:
CLEAN COLOUR BLOCKS — BLUE ANCHOR. Make this a clearly more restrained, blue-dominant sibling of image 1. About three quarters of the A is solid ultramarine. The upper arch is almost entirely blue, with a broad crisp yellow planar swatch occupying only the outer left shoulder near its lower end. In the lower piece, one bold vermilion polygon crosses the central crossbar and stops before the right foot, with the two feet reading mostly blue. A tiny pink quadrilateral can meet the red at the far left. Use only a few hard straight internal boundaries, aligned thoughtfully with the A's rising diagonal. Absolutely flat solid opaque inks with crisp vector-like edges and no texture. The change is deliberate colour placement and more blue breathing room, not a new A shape.
